subject: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for your time yesterday. As discussed, I pulled together a concise proposal that combines a hybrid livestream sponsorship with a micro-stage demo kiosk and an invite-only breakfast roundtable for your target accounts. Key bullets from our side: 

- Micro-stage: 30-minute demo window each day (3 total demos across the 2-day conference); onsite AV + dedicated tech operator included.
- Livestream: your logo on live lower-third during Redwood sessions; 90-second pre-roll sponsor mention for keynote livestreams (US stream).
- Breakfast roundtable: exclusive morning session for up to 20 VIPs (networking + 15-min moderated fireside).
- Priority logo placement: main sponsor tier but we need clarity on logo ordering (hero vs. supporting).

I attached a short SOW and the latest floorplan (rev C) for the micro-stage footprint. Can you confirm whether Redwood needs guaranteed demo windows or if you're flexible to swap with other partners? Also, pricing below reflects a hybrid premium to cover streaming ops and closed-roundtable facilitation. 

Attachment stubs: SW_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), exhibit_floor_revC.png (png)

Would love a quick yes/no on the demo guarantees so I can lock your slot and follow up with a DocuSign.

Best,
Elena Morales
Partnerships Lead — SummitWorks Events
elena@summitworks.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights

Elena —

Appreciate the write-up and the SOW. Quick answers: Redwood wants guaranteed demo windows (we need predictable customer invites to staff demos), and we want the breakfast roundtable to be an invite-only account-targeted list (20 pax cap is good).

Couple of asks from our side before we sign: 
1) Logo hierarchy: Redwood needs hero placement on the livestream lower-third during our sessions and top-left placement on the morning recap slide deck shared with attendees.
2) Demo cadence: please guarantee at least one 30-minute slot during peak exhibit hours (Fri 11:30–12:00) — the other two can be flex.
3) Media rights: we need a 6-month on-demand clip hosting for lead-gen (no extra fee).

We are comfortable with the hybrid premium if those three items are firm. Marissa/Soojin — can you confirm operations can staff the guaranteed Fri 11:30–12:00 demo slot and handle the VIP list?

Thanks — if Elena can confirm logo placement and the media rights clause, I can route for DocuSign today.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Morales <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@keynoteco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights

Thanks — good clarifications. Confirming each point: 
- Logo hierarchy: we can commit hero placement on the livestream lower-third for all Redwood-branded sessions and top-left on the morning recap deck. We'll mark this in the SOW.
- Demo cadence: Fri 11:30–12:00 is reserved for Redwood; we'll show as "Reserved" on the public schedule and internally keep the other 2 slots flexible but recommended at 14:00 (Thu) and 10:30 (Fri).
- Media rights: SummitWorks can grant 6-month hosting of the session clips for lead-gen use; we'll include a clause that SummitWorks may also use short promotional clips (<=15s) for event marketing, with shared credit.

I've added Tom Chen (production) who will confirm AV/streaming specs. I've attached the revised SOW with the logo hierarchy marked and a microstage operations timeline workbook for your ops team.

Attachment stubs: SW_SOW_v2.pdf (updated), microstage_timeline.xlsx (xlsx)

Tom — can you confirm feed format and whether the 90-second pre-roll will run before both keynote and the Redwood micro-stage live stream?

Warmly,
Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@summitworks.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights

Elena / team —

Ops note from Redwood: we can staff the guaranteed Fri 11:30–12:00 demo. Staffing plan: 1 product PM + 1 solutions engineer + 1 on-site AE for customer invites (Marissa will send RSVP list). We need the micro-stage AV patch to include a second laptop feed for live-coding and an HDMI loop for the streaming encoder.

Two small contract edits requested (I'll mark and return): 
- Add explicit 30-minute blocked demo windows (Fri 11:30–12:00 guaranteed).
- Remove SummitWorks right to use full-length session recordings for paid advertising; 15s promotional clips ok with credit (as Elena proposed).

If you can send a DocuSign with those edits I will get internal approvals and confirm the VIP list by Wednesday EOD (Sep 2).

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Elena Morales <elena@summitworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Chen <tom.chen@keynoteco.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid livestream + micro-stage: breakfast roundtable & demo kiosk rights

Marissa / Karthik —

Perfect — appreciate the quick ops confirmation. I've updated the SOW to reflect the two edits (demo window guaranteed + promotional clip limit) and requested the DocuSign for SW-2026-0421. Draft link is below: 

https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123-SW-2026

Tom confirms the 90s pre-roll will run before the keynote livestream only; we can schedule a separate 60s sponsor mention on the micro-stage stream if you'd like (small incremental fee). For now I left the micro-stage with the 15s credit-only promos per Marissa's note.

I'll send the DocuSign and once signed we'll lock the Fri 11:30–12:00 slot and request your VIP list. Let me know if you'd like the 60s micro-stage mention and I'll add to the DocuSign.

Thanks — Elena
SummitWorks Events
elena@summitworks.com
